What we stock

Inventory turns over fast — this is the shape of what we carry. Call ahead if you're hunting something specific and we'll check the case for you.

01

Singles & bulk

Commons and near-mint singles for Pokémon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, and more, priced from $.25 on up.

Digging through the binders at the counter is half the fun — new pulls go in regularly.

02

Sealed product

Booster boxes, ETBs, premium collection boxes, and tins for current and recent sets.

New releases go on the shelf as soon as they land — stop in or call to ask what just came in.

03

Graded slabs & trade

PSA and BGS graded cards on display, plus an active buy-sell-trade counter for your own collection.

Bring in a binder or a box and we'll make you a fair offer, cash or trade credit.

04

Funko, manga & plush

Funko Pop! figures, manga volumes, and plushies of your favorite Pokémon.

The Funko wall changes often — exclusives and new waves don't last long.

05

Extras & accessories

Backpacks, pins, keychains, sleeves, and a small case of retro games and consoles.

Good gift territory if you're shopping for a collector who has almost everything.

Our story

Built by collectors, for collectors

Our spot — string lights on, sign lit, open for business.

Why Psystrike

Psystrike Cards and Collectibles started the way most good shops do: a growing binder, a love of the trade table, and a gap in Tallahassee for a shop that took both the cards and the community seriously. You'll find us tucked into Railroad Square, Tallahassee's creative arts district — string lights overhead, an OPEN sign lit up, unit 1D.

We're not a big-box aisle — we're the counter where the person ringing you up actually collects the stuff on the shelf, knows a fair price on a graded slab, and will tell you honestly if a box isn't worth it right now.

Whether you're digging through the quarter bin for your first binder or bringing in a box to trade, this is a shop built around the counter conversation, not just the checkout.

  • Fair pricingSingles priced from bulk bin to graded slab — nothing marked up just because it's rare.
  • Always tradingBring a binder or a box to the counter — buy, sell, or trade, no appointment needed.
  • Straight answersIf a box is overhyped or a card's about to reprint, we'll tell you before you buy.
  • Local firstIndependently run in Tallahassee — every dollar stays close to home.
